missing: Three refutations. (1) Nothing is durable: ExperimentLog lives in memory only — a restart forgets every experiment and every applied transition, so 'durable transitions' and kill-and-resume cannot occur (vc_201_011_mastery_restart_forgets_everything). (2) A failed leg has no exit: only Evaluated can reach Rejected, so an experiment failing in Isolation is wedged forever and still reports resume_requires_evaluation (vc_201_011_mastery_failed_isolation_has_no_exit). (3) propose() on an existing id silently resets state while applied_transitions survives, permanently wedging the experiment (vc_201_011_mastery_repropose_wedges_the_experiment). Nothing outside tests calls ExperimentLog. Holds: the legal transition chain, evaluation-skip refusal, and duplicate-edge refusal (vc_201_011_mastery_transition_table_holds).
